artifacts.notes: The artifact's PDF metadata names the Internet Archive item. Optical text was used only to locate the Psalm expositions; the registered passages were inspected in the facsimile pages. Artifact-page numbers are one-based PDF pages, not the damaged printed pagination.
artifacts.rights_basis: The English edition was published in 1866 and is in the United States public domain by publication date. Bellarmine died in 1621. The exact PDF is a mechanical scan of that public-domain printing; Wikimedia Commons identifies Internet Archive as its source and marks the file public domain.

edition.notes: First English translation, by John O'Sullivan, expressly abridged by its translator. The exact registered scan has 482 artifact pages. Its first surviving leaves are damaged or incomplete around the title, so the publication identity was cross-checked against the National Library of Ireland catalog and the scan's own prefatory matter.
edition.title: Commentary on the Book of Psalms, translated by John O'Sullivan

work.author: Robert Bellarmine
work.description: Bellarmine's verse-by-verse exposition of the Psalms. The 1866 English expression is materially abridged by its translator, who says that he omitted philological discussion, variant readings, and Bellarmine's individual Psalm prefaces; claims drawn from that expression must not be represented as controlling the complete Latin work.
work.title: Explanatio in Psalmos
